title: Adaptive prediction theory combining offline and online learning
abstract: arXiv:2512.00342v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Real-world intelligence systems usually operate by combining offline learning and online adaptation with highly correlated and non-stationary system data or signals, which, however, has rarely been investigated theoretically in the literature. This paper initiates a theoretical investigation on the prediction performance of a two-stage learning framework combining offline and online algorithms for a class of nonlinear stochastic dynamical systems. For the offline-learning phase, we establish an upper bound on the generalization error for approximate nonlinear-least-squares estimation under general datasets with strong correlation and distribution shift, leveraging the Kullback-Leibler divergence to quantify the distributional discrepancies. translated_title: 结合离线与在线学习的自适应预测理论
translated_abstract: arXiv:2512.00342v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：现实世界中的智能系统通常通过结合离线学习和在线适应来处理高度相关且非平稳的系统数据或信号，然而，这在文献中鲜有理论研究。本文针对一类非线性随机动力系统，对结合离线与在线算法的两阶段学习框架的预测性能进行了理论探讨。在离线学习阶段，我们利用Kullback-Leibler散度量化分布差异，在具有强相关性和分布偏移的一般数据集上，建立了近似非线性最小二乘估计的泛化误差上界。在在线适应阶段，我们在离线训练模型的基础上，针对现实目标系统中可能出现的不确定参数漂移，提出了一种元LMS预测算法。
tldr: 本文首次从理论上研究了结合离线与在线学习的自适应预测框架，在非线性随机动力系统中给出了离线阶段泛化误差上界，并提出了应对参数漂移的元LMS预测算法。
en_tdlr: This paper initiates a theoretical study on a two-stage adaptive prediction framework combining offline and online learning, establishing a generalization error bound for offline estimation and proposing a meta-LMS algorithm to handle parameter drift in nonlinear stochastic systems.
